Grow your paper realm,
one patch at a time.

Patchland: Claim It All is an offline territory game. Trace, place and spread to win land from quirky AI lords, and watch your color grow across a paper map. Short rounds, no internet needed.

Ways to take land

Not released yet. Store pages and details will be posted here when they are ready.

Ways to take land

Pick a game on the first screen. The land you win is added to one realm map.

Trace

Leave your land, draw a line and come back home. Everything you circle becomes yours.

Spread

Pick a color and every touching patch of that color joins your land.

Place

Take turns putting a stone on a hex board. Seal off a small group of enemy stones and they turn yours.

Turf Hockey

Cells the puck crosses go to whoever hit it last. Move your mallet and guard your turf.

Today's Land

One board a day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going.

More games are in the works.

At a glance

  • Offline play against AI lords, no internet needed
  • A 24-region paper map with 6 neighbor lords and boss matches
  • Lord Album: collect cards of the lords as you play
  • Practice any game at Easy, Normal or Hard
  • Color-blind patterns, plus sound and vibration switches
  • No ads, no subscription, no analytics
